sections.h2: Nail salon branding: what customers see before they book
sections.html:
Most new customers meet your salon on a phone. They look at photos, read a few reviews, check prices and decide quickly. Only later do they see the sign and the menu at the front desk.

Nail salon branding means those moments tell one story. In practice:

  • A name and logo people can read from the road and remember when a friend asks where they had their nails done.
  • Colours and type used the same way on the sign, the menu, the cards and your posts.
  • A voice: how you greet people, describe a service and answer a review.
  • A clear menu, grouped the way customers ask for services.

Already have a logo you like? Our Refresh package keeps what works and updates the rest.

sections.h2: Social media for nail salons: we set it up, your team runs it
sections.html:
We are honest about the model. We do not post for you every day, run ads or do photo shoots. The best content is already in your technicians' hands: a finished set, filmed on a phone in good light.

We build the system around those photos. The brand work gives you post templates in your colours. The automation add-on adds a 30-day calendar and captions drafted in natural English, with Vietnamese where your customers use it.

You explain things to us in Vietnamese, as you would to a friend. We turn that into English that sounds like a real salon, not a translation.

See how it works on our page about social media automation for nail salons, or start today with these nail salon social media content ideas.

process.title: Six steps, and you approve after each one

items.p: A 60-minute conversation in Vietnamese. We listen to the founder's story: why you started, what you believe in, which customers you want to reach and what you want from the business.

Who the salon is for and how it is different. We analyse the salons around you in depth to see where you stand and which direction to take next, based on what the founder wants, then write the brand story and key messages.

We work directly with the founder and the person in charge of the brand: a name if needed, logo, colours, typography and voice. We agree on every part together and pack it into guidelines, so the brand can be built over the long term.

Once customers start to recognise the brand, we take it where they already go: menu, signage, cards, website, social media (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, LinkedIn, Zalo, Pinterest) and the media channels they follow. If you already have channels, we read their data, customer behaviour and past campaign results, then advise you on a strategy for new campaigns.

A brand that grows without a community behind it is not yet a successful brand, and repeat purchases from a good community save a lot of sales and marketing spend. We help you build your community on the platforms your customers prefer, so they stay loyal.

Every brand meets a communication crisis at some point. Our team specialises in studying and handling crises, keeps the impact and risk to your brand as small as possible, and trains your team to respond the way communication professionals do.

faq.q: Do you run ads or post for us every day?
faq.a: No, and we do not do photo shoots either. We build the brand and the system, and your own team posts.

faq.q: Is the content in English and Vietnamese?
faq.a: Yes. We talk with you in Vietnamese and write for your customers in English, adding Vietnamese where they use it.

faq.q: How does a nail salon marketing agency in Vietnam work across time zones?
